title.zh: 露营地场地与用品助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Replenish wash-block supplies and maintain clear stock-count notes.
requirements.zh: 补充卫浴区用品，并维护清晰库存计数备注。

requirements.en: Complete prescribed litter rounds and report unidentified materials without mixing them into ordinary waste.
requirements.zh: 完成规定垃圾巡查，并报告无法识别的材料，不将其混入普通垃圾。

requirements.en: Report maintenance issues, display confirmed closure notices and hand over unfinished work.
requirements.zh: 报告维护问题、展示已确认关闭告示，并交接未完成工作。

requirements.en: Operate ride-on grounds machinery and utility buggies after site induction.
requirements.zh: 在场地入职培训后操作乘坐式场地机械及运输车。
